This is a mixed and very complex problem. To resolve this, we have to check following problems step by step.

* The caption of figures are generated by docutils, not Sphinx
* The caption of code-blocks are generated by Sphinx
* Sphinx-1.5 does not support HTML5 yet

The first one needs to update our code. Sphinx uses `<div>` tag to represent the caption of code-blocks.

And second one needs to update docutils. The html5 writer of docutils also uses `<div>` tag to represent the caption of figures. Could you request to use `<figcaption>` to the project?

The last one will be resolved in next major release (refs: #3464). With the release, we can use the html5 writer of docutils. So second problem will be resolved after update of the library.
The problem of `<figcaption>` needs both update of Sphinx and docutils.
Note: The html5 writer in Sphinx is still experimental.
